fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x83B4B0 (esv::notification::System lambda over esv::lock::UnlockedEventOneFrameComponent; variant tag 0x2E = UnlockedEventNotificationRequest) puts the event's owner entity (the door/chest LockSystem::FinalizeLockRequests unlocked) at request +0 and the event's Key at +8. Dispatcher bg3.exe+0x2DF53B0 case 0x2E creates this component (creator bg3.exe+0x2DF3460) and stores the Guid of request +0 (FUN_142B8DC50, entity -> uuid) at +0: the entity that was unlocked.

fields.name: Key
